keyFindings.description: The text implies that a main run gets the 2-minute cache hit when its inputs did not change. But packages/envoy/docker/Dockerfile:76-84 takes LEGION_COMMIT (github.sha, passed by both builds) into the build stage's Go build ldflags. So every commit misses at that step, and with mode=min (no intermediate records) the whole build stage and the web stage it copies from run again. A push run on main gets about the miss time (4.2-6.9 min, still under 8). The 2.00/1.60 hit was a re-run at the same sha. Correct the doc bullet and the PR body: name LEGION_COMMIT, and give the miss figures as the expected time on main.
